uncovered_constraints_packaged: R04 validates a same-run cumulative runtime ledger containing exactly R01,R02,R03, all three handoff bytes and transitive hashes before runtime work, and never edits predecessor state.

R04 independently asserts profiler_execution_performed, trace_collection_performed, pmc_collection_performed, report_generation_performed and attribution_performed are all false in R02; validator-only corrections require an empty R04 root and a complete repeated predecessor gate.
The complete batch8 contract is explicit: eight ordered 16-32K requests, concurrency eight, infinite request rate, 1024 output tokens, two excluded warmups, temperature zero and ignored EOS.

Every model execution and formal capture keeps physical devices 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, rank 0 to device 0, rank 1 to device 1, world size two, TP1, PP1 and DP2 mp; profiler pass splitting never reduces the workload to one device.
The pinned service environment, launcher and steady-state readiness are recorded per rank; cold compilation is followed by the required same-binding restart and does not replace request warmups.
R03 remains the sole timing/order source and R04 treats all rocprofv2 PMC clocks, dispatch order and throughput as replay-only diagnostics, never latency.

The selection plan comes only from all R03 representative parent/process/family rows, preserves order, expands declared fragments, retains no-kernel rows and never adds R04 marker ranges or a new timing ranking.

The locked plan proves 62 representative rows, 58 PMC-eligible logical targets, four no-kernel rows and 26 unique-literal capture batches; expected mappings are dynamically summed from selected_literal_r03_instance_count and currently derive as 66, never 89.
Every device preflight first captures installed hy-smi help, chooses supported read-only PID/utilization/memory queries and uses unique immutable empty attempt directories.

rocprof list-basic/list-derived stdout, stderr and exit codes are preserved; a parseable gpu-agent/counter/formula catalog may survive the fixed list-only exit-one diagnostic, while every actual replay still requires exit zero and nonempty attributable per-dispatch evidence.

The broken fixed-DTK legacy rocprof is rejected despite its help text; rocprofv2 is admitted only after a real small DCU smoke proves nonempty per-dispatch counters, usable columns and HIP API/HCC operation correlation.
hip-api alone and kernel-trace are insufficient for this fixed PMC mode; every formal pass retains hip-trace HCC operations and proves a nonzero HCC-to-PMC dispatch join.

A nonexistent-literal probe empirically sets collector_kernel_filter_empirically_effective in capability, plan, raw manifest, validation and report; when false, raw retains the minimum bounded complete-request superset and projection excludes non-target rows.

The replay wrapper explicitly prepends the target source and R04 tools to PYTHONPATH, the fixed DTK dcc/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH, resolves target venv Python and proves target Python-tree plus installed ABI provenance.
Tool revisions preserve old plans, manifests, helpers and failed raw attempts, record old/new hashes, seal new manifests and rebuild all hash-pinned metadata before retry.

Every projected dispatch independently follows exact literal, exact replay R02 HIPTX range, owned HIP launch, retained HCC/PMC correlation and exact normalized R03 operation subsequence; name, overlap, proximity, replay order and shared raw are insufficient.
All unmatched, non-target, duplicate and ambiguous native rows remain in immutable raw data with reason codes and never enter the hardware projection.
Hardware metrics retain native counters, formulas, units, pass, rank/device, catalog and tool provenance; unavailable DCU equivalents are labeled rather than fabricated or set to zero.

Normalizer and independent auditor separately derive expected mapping multiplicities and enforce mapped_dispatch_count equals a positive expected_mapped_dispatch_count; valid raw data receives offline repair rather than recapture.
Capture-time and analysis-time tool hashes remain distinct, analysis manifests cite the capture manifest and every replay execution manifest retains original capture provenance.

The main report has one row per R03 matched_kernel_family, retains R03 order/start only as immutable context, labels inherited NCU/nsys/NVTX fields as compatibility aliases and excludes Workflow 02 timing evidence columns.

Control-plane stream interruptions require state/Goal/PID/pass/manifest inspection, constrained reuse of the canonical R04 artifact root, immutable quarantine of incomplete passes and new empty roots for recapture.

Historical single-card timing, traces, device mappings, handoffs, PMC rows and reports cannot satisfy the fresh R04 lineage; workload_profile contributes only taxonomy, vocabulary, schemas and reconstruction method.

Business artifacts remain under runtime_artifact_root and one scheduler handoff is written only to runtime_handoff_output after every coverage, provenance, report and hash gate passes; R05 cannot start earlier.
